summary: The article provides a generally reliable overview of Paras Defence's Q4 FY26 results, with most key financial figures aligning across multiple sources. However, there are some discrepancies in the reported revenue and net profit figures, likely due to different reporting bases (consolidated vs. standalone or slight variations in calculation).

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue for Q4 FY26 increased by 60.6% year-on-year to ₹180.36 crores, while net profit surged by 86.7% year-on-year to ₹38.88 crores.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm these consolidated figures for Q4 FY26. Total income was ₹180.36 crores, up 60.6% YoY, and net profit (PAT) was ₹38.88 crores, up 86.7% YoY.

claims.claim: The company reported a consolidated revenue of ₹180.36 crores for the quarter ended March 2026, marking a significant 60.6% increase year-on-year (YoY) from ₹112.28 crores in Q4 FY25.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the consolidated total income of ₹180.36 crores for Q4 FY26, a 60.6% YoY increase from ₹112.28 crores in Q4 FY25.

claims.claim: On a quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) basis, revenue grew by 66.0% from ₹108.62 crores in Q3 FY26.
claims.note: Sources confirm consolidated total income grew 66.0% QoQ from ₹108.62 crores in Q3 FY26 to ₹180.36 crores in Q4 FY26.

claims.claim: Profitability also saw a sharp ascent, with the net profit reaching ₹38.88 crores in Q4 FY26. This represents an impressive 86.7% YoY growth from ₹20.83 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, and a 130.7% QoQ growth from ₹16.85 crores in Q3 FY26.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm these consolidated net profit figures and growth percentages for Q4 FY26.

claims.claim: The Profit Before Tax (PBT) stood at ₹48.44 crores, showing a remarkable 108.8% QoQ increase.
claims.note: Sources confirm consolidated PBT of ₹48.44 crores for Q4 FY26, an increase of 108.8% QoQ.

claims.claim: The Earnings Per Share (EPS) for Q4 FY26 was ₹4.27, reflecting an 88.9% QoQ improvement, although it was a 12.7% decline YoY from ₹4.89 in Q4 FY25.
claims.note: Sources confirm the basic and diluted EPS for Q4 FY26 was ₹4.27, with an 88.9% QoQ improvement and a 12.7% decline YoY from ₹4.89 in Q4 FY25.

claims.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share for FY26 also reflects a healthy financial position and a commitment to shareholder returns.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the board recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share for FY26.

article_title: Analyzing Paras Defence's Share Price Outlook for 3 Years
